title: The Best Universal Remotes
subtitle: Universal remotes and hubs that control your TV, streamer, and smart home, ranked.
intro: We pulled the universal remotes on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: a hub for hidden devices, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi control, and smart home support.
systems_note: SwitchBot remotes join Matter through the included hub. SofaBaton's X2 has a Home Assistant integration.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.why: SwitchBot's remote and Matter hub bundle, rated 4.2 stars by 5,308 buyers.

awards.label: Best for Home Assistant
awards.why: A touchscreen remote that can also control Home Assistant over MQTT.

awards.label: Best for Home Theater
awards.why: One-touch activities across a 500,000-device code library, with Alexa and Google.

buyers_guide.q: Why a universal remote with a hub?
buyers_guide.a: The hub controls devices hidden in a cabinet over IR, Bluetooth, and Wi-Fi, and a single button can switch on the TV, soundbar, and streamer together.

buyers_guide.q: Will it control my streaming stick?
buyers_guide.a: Bluetooth remotes and hubs can control Fire TV, Roku, and Apple TV. Check the device list in the listing.
Logitech discontinued Harmony remotes, so the picks here are from brands still making and updating them.
